changeSet.comment: Add definition for Provisiond partial node scan lifecycle event.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO eventconf_events(id, source_id, uei, event_label, description, enabled, xml_content, created_time, last_modified, modified_by) SELECT m.mx + 1, ps.id, 'uei.opennms.org/internal/provisiond/nodeScanPartiallyCompleted', 'OpenNMS-defined Provisiond Event: nodeScanPartiallyCompleted', 'A message from the Provisiond NodeScan lifecycle that a NodeScan completed with one or more discovery failures:

The Node with Id: %nodeid%; ForeignSource: %parm[foreignSource]%; ForeignId:%parm[foreignId]% completed with %parm[provisionFailedTaskCount]% failed task(s). Requisition data was applied; SNMP discovery may be incomplete.

', TRUE, ' uei.opennms.org/internal/provisiond/nodeScanPartiallyCompleted OpenNMS-defined Provisiond Event: nodeScanPartiallyCompleted A message from the Provisiond NodeScan lifecycle that a NodeScan completed with one or more discovery failures: <p>The Node with Id: %nodeid%; ForeignSource: %parm[foreignSource]%; ForeignId:%parm[foreignId]% completed with %parm[provisionFailedTaskCount]% failed task(s). Requisition data was applied; SNMP discovery may be incomplete.</p> <p>The Node with Id: %nodeid%; ForeignSource: %parm[foreignSource]%; ForeignId:%parm[foreignId]% completed with %parm[provisionFailedTaskCount]% failed discovery step(s).</p> Warning ', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system-migration' FROM (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) AS mx FROM eventconf_events) AS m, eventconf_sources ps WHERE ps.name = 'opennms.provisioning.events' LIMIT 1;
